claim.claim-text: 1. A light detecting apparatus comprising light detecting elements arranged in a two-dimensional array, each light detecting element comprising:

a photoelectric conversion unit including a first electrode (11), a photoelectric conversion layer (13), and a second electrode (12), the photoelectric conversion layer (13) being disposed between the first electrode (11) and the second electrode (12), wherein the photoelectric conversion unit further includes a charge storage electrode (14) and an insulating layer (82), the photoelectric conversion layer (13) being disposed between the charge storage electrode (14) and the second electrode (12), and the insulating layer (82) being disposed between the charge storage electrode (14) and the photoelectric conversion layer (13), and the photoelectric conversion unit being configured to control photoelectric conversion by applying a potential to a part of the photoelectric conversion layer (13) between the charge storage electrode (14) and the second electrode (12) that has an absolute value larger than an absolute value of a potential applied to a region of the photoelectric conversion layer (13) between a charge movement control electrode (21) and the second electrode (12), the region being positioned between the light detecting element and an adjacent light detecting element, and wherein a plurality of light detecting elements including the light detecting element and the adjacent light detecting element are included in a light detecting element block, and the first electrode is shared by the plurality of light detecting elements in the light detecting element block.
2. The light detecting apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising:
a semiconductor substrate, wherein the photoelectric conversion unit is arranged on an upper side of the semiconductor substrate.

3. The light detecting apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising: a transfer control electrode arranged between the first electrode and the charge storage electrode, arranged apart from the first electrode and the charge storage electrode, and arranged to face the photoelectric conversion layer through the insulating layer.
4. The light detecting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the charge storage electrode includes a plurality of charge storage electrode segments.
5. The light detecting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the size of the charge storage electrode is larger than the first electrode.
